about: Fixed issues that must not come back. Checked before commit/push and in CI by ut-sdet-reviewer/scripts/regression_guard.py.

guards.title: Cards must not set their own max width
guards.why: Per-card widths made cards narrower than page headings and left a ragged right edge; the shared [data-page] column in app/(app)/layout.tsx sets the width
guards.fix: Remove max-w from the card; let the page column size it

guards.title: Put sr-only on a wrapper, not on a table (tables ignore the 1px size and widen the page on phones)
Migrations must be safe to run twice
guards.regex: ^(?:create table|create (?:unique )?index|alter table \S+ add column) (?!if not exists)
guards.why: Running a migration a second time in the SQL editor failed with 'already exists' (42701) and stopped midway.
guards.fix: Use 'if not exists' on tables, indexes and columns; put 'drop ... if exists' before triggers, policies and constraints.
